INTRO_KR: Grand Mom Aead is a dedicated farmer, cultivates a variety of crops, including cashew nuts. These cashew trees are carefully grown in soil that is completely natural and located near the seashore in Nakhon Si Thammarat Province (Southern Thailand). which results in exceptional products. The cashew nuts harvested from these trees possess a firm texture, delightful sweetness, and are packed with over 10 different vitamins, maintaining their original deliciousness. The ancient burning process, an age-old traditional recipe that has been passed down for more than 100 years old. The process begins by bringing freshly harvested cashew nuts to dry naturally under the sun for a period of 3-4 days. Once the nuts have achieved the desired level of dryness, they undergo a high-temperature burning process. Unlike conventional methods such as baking, frying, or boiling, this traditional incineration does not involve the use of oil. Consequently, the resulting cashew nuts do not contain unhealthy cholesterol. Furthermore, this unique "burning" process sets it apart by preserving the cashew nuts' 100% natural fruitiness, ensuring a distinct and authentic flavor.

INTRO_KR: Hubei Baoxun Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. was founded on April 8, 2020, specializing in edible fungus strain research and breeding, experimental demonstration planting, and technical promotion services. In October 2021, the company was approved as a provincial expert workstation, implementing the "academician expert + project" model to conduct research on rare edible fungus technologies. The company's technical team has successively developed 8 new edible fungus varieties certified at national or provincial level, obtained 8 national authorized patents, and registered 6 scientific and technological achievements. It has also established Suizhou Edible and Medicinal Fungus Germplasm Resource Preservation and Evaluation Center and a breeding base, which has long collected and preserved over 30,000 strains of various edible and medicinal fungus resources in Hubei Province. The company can produce and sell 1.5 million catties of strains, process 300,000 fungus sticks, and produce 800,000 catties of various edible fungi annually. In addition, the company has explored a new path of integrating agriculture and tourism, combining strain research, demonstration planting, science popularization, and sightseeing picking to contribute to rural revitalization.

INTRO_KR: "Jiangyin Fuma Wine Technology Co., Ltd. With the corporate ethos of ""Adding Value to Agriculture, Enhancing Benefits for Farmers, and Creating a Sustainable Sci-tech Enterprise"" , the company is dedicated to revitalizing traditional brewing techniques through modern technology. By leveraging in-depth industry-university-research collaboration with the School of Biotechnology Engineering at Jiangnan University, it has pioneered novel fermentation technologies to transform surplus fruits into premium fruit wines. This innovation not only increases farmers' income and reduces losses but also promotes the resource utilization of agricultural waste. In 2019, the company achieved a milestone as Jiangsu's first rice wine enterprise to obtain the U.S. FDA 10-year Inspection Exemption Certification. Combining non-legacy craftsmanship with cutting-edge R&D, it has launched the culturally distinctive ""Jiangyin Hao"" and ""Zui Jiangnan"" series of clear rice wines. These products are uniquely blended with floral and fruity elements like peach and green plum, crafting a fragrant portfolio that embodies regional heritage. Looking ahead, the company will continue to deepen its expertise in green brewing with an artisan spirit.
